newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour denies Conservatives' spending claims.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour denies Conservatives' spending claims.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour party on Wednesday angrily denied claims by the ruling Conservatives that it had made spending commitments that would cost 30 billion pounds to fulfil.
Finance spokesman Alistair Darling said items represented as spending pledges by Chief Secretary to the Treasury William Waldegrave were "rubbish".

"None of the things I have seen are commitments at all. They are selective quotes from speeches," Darling told BBC radio. "What we see here is the same old Tory lie machine coming up with half-baked things that have no foundation."
